title: I Worked 3 Jobs At Once. Here's Every Lie About Overemployment
description:
Think you can handle a second job and want one delivered on a silver platter without the tedious job search  https://jumpseatjobs.com/?video=3o2MgCGP2kI

Best duos of all time:
-Woody and Buzz 
-Spongebob and Patrick 
-Lilo and Stitch 
And of course Adam and Jamie of Mythbusters. While I know nothing about science, I do know about working multiple jobs simultaneously. 

So let's go mythbusters on all the most common complaints people have against overemployment. 

 Uploaded from the back corner of JFK Airport Terminal 4 waiting for my flight back to Mexico.
